caption: The image depicts a drawing of a metallic cross set against a plain, off-white or beige background. The cross consists of a vertical and a horizontal bar intersecting at right angles, both of which are rendered in a textured, dark brown color resembling rusted or aged iron. The intersection of the bars is enclosed within a circular ring of the same material and color. Each of the four ends of the crossbars extends beyond the circle and is capped with a pointed arrowhead shape; the top and sides of these arrowheads are embellished with small, symmetrical curled flourishes. The bottom section of the vertical bar is significantly longer than the other arms and ends bluntly with a straight edge. The drawing is centered on the canvas, and beneath the cross, towards the bottom right, there is a small signature in blue ink.
title: Iron Cross
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
